name: ab-dusk
rationale: A single horizontal narrative on dusk navy — solid gold origin dot, ink round-capped arrow (170 shaft, 45-degree chevron head) pointing to a hollow ink-ringed destination — four flat geometric shapes, three brand tones, optically centered with equal 156-unit edge clearances so it reads instantly at 60x60.

name: ab-crimson
rationale: A loud flat-crimson field carries the A-to-B journey grammar — gold origin dot, ink arrow, hollow ink destination ring — in five-or-fewer round-capped geometric shapes that stay legible at 60 px.

name: ribbon-dusk
rationale: A single point-symmetric crimson S-ribbon (one smooth cubic path, 130-wide round caps) sweeps from (300,200) to (724,824) across a dusk-navy ground, with a gold origin dot and ink destination dot seated inside the ribbon's end caps like transit stops — four flat shapes, no text, legible at 60x60.

name: ribbon-crimson
rationale: A single 130-unit ink S-ribbon on solid crimson — its round-capped cubic sweeping diagonally through center (512,512) with ~100-unit lateral swing — reads instantly at 60px as a route from a gold origin dot to a deep-crimson destination dot, both seated inside the ribbon at its caps.

name: grid-badge
rationale: A crimson badge with an ink navigation kite (rotated exactly 40 degrees, centroid-corrected to sit optically dead-center) floats over a whisper-quiet street grid drawn purely by the #1a1b2e-on-#0f1020 tone step, keeping three layers, four elements, and three brand tones.
